g.text: End-to-end time and reported peak RSS across ten datasets
Within each panel: Time uses the left axis; RSS uses the right axis. Linear scales; RSS scale shared across panels. Lower is better.
TO: 4 h timeout (no completed-run time). ~: v1 Ratebeer throughput from a timed-out run. Hatched RSS: v2 main process only; child processes excluded.
Historical runs and selected v2 reruns; cache states / epoch counts differ; v2 Ratebeer is capped. RSS for timed-out runs is the peak observed before timeout.
